title: Oven Roasted Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A solo dinner dish featuring lamb kebabs with gorgonzola dolce and caramelized onions, perfect for a keto friendly meal. This dish is inspired by Saudi Arabian cuisine and has a grassy and bouncy flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the lamb kebabs in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
While the lamb is cooking, caramelize the sliced onions in a pan over medium heat.
After the lamb has cooked for 20 minutes, top each kebab with crumbled gorgonzola dolce and caramelized onions.
Return the kebabs to the oven and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
